mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate level below 0.5% indicates sustained monetary accommodation, reducing discount rates for equity cash flows and producing positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns due to increased liquidity in financial markets.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% signals robust labor market conditions that increase consumer spending capacity and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous acceleration in GDP growth (GDPC1) above 0.5% and retail sales growth (RSAFS) above 0.3% signals strong consumer demand, increasing corporate revenue visibility and producing positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 growth > 0.5% and RSAFS growth > 0.3%.

mechanism_narrative: A monetary tightening cycle defined by FEDFUNDS rising above 0.5% with positive monthly change signals reduced liquidity and higher discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 0.5% and FEDFUNDS change > 0.05%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 (relative to 2017=100) signals weakening manufacturing output, reducing corporate production capacity and earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 850 thousand units (HOUST) indicates strong residential construction activity, supporting consumer confidence and retail sector growth, producing positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where HOUST > 850.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly non-farm payrolls increase exceeding 0.5% signals robust job creation, boosting consumer income and discretionary spending, which drives positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS growth > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate level below 0.5% sustains low discount rates for equity valuation over the medium term, producing positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns through extended monetary accommodation.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%.
